【原视频简介】
Apple’s 2026 desktop Mac lineup looks simple—until memory, storage, and Apple’s pricing ladder push you toward the next machine.

In this pre-release buying guide, I compare the M6 Mac mini, M5 Pro Mac mini, M5 Max Mac Studio, and M5 Ultra Mac Studio. The real decision is not simply which chip is fastest. It is how much unified memory your workload needs, whether you are CPU- or GPU-limited, and whether your configuration has crossed into the next product tier.

This video is based on Apple specifications and U.S. pricing available on August 31, 2026. Independent testing of shipping hardware was still pending at the time of production.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Introduction
01:49 Choose Memory First
03:57 M6 vs M5 Pro
05:51 M5 Max & M5 Ultra
07:57 Local AI
09:01 Price Crossovers
10:36 My Recommendations

CORRECTION
In the United States, doing a storage upgrade yourself does not automatically void the entire warranty. Apple may exclude damage caused by the upgrade, and consumer rights vary by country.
